about_the_game:
In this world fantastical creatures with the ability to enter beads roam free, in fact in some cases they are more prevalent than humans,

In this game you’ll get your start as a bead wielder by visiting the head researcher’s lab there you’ll get a once in a lifetime opportunity to aid in the study of creaturebeads, Should you accept it you’ll be partnered with unique creaturebeads thought to be extinct, throughout your journey you’ll encounter many species of CreaturesBeads, and befriend other beadwielders, you’ll be offered many different opportunities under your new skills as a BeadWielder but underneath the happy and bustling world trouble is brewing.

Follow different playable character storylines,

Be recruited to different pathways of a BeadWielder,

Collect and best over 80 unique creatures and counting,

Explore this unique land spreading from mountainous to seaside,

Introducing creaturebeads mint

Hope you’ll enjoy it
